label: sec:gb-spectral-sequence-intro
title: Six mass terms as spectral-sequence pages
html: The unified knot mass formula (unified knot mass) comprises six structural terms. These emerge as pages of a spectral sequence associated with the Gröbner–Shirshov filtration J^\bullet(q) on H_n(R, q). The following makes this spectral-sequence structure precise and states the E_\infty convergence target.
